title: Flags for the Gate

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Welcome to Bellhaven! Did you walk the whole road? Then you passed the old watchtower on the way.

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: We hang flags over the city gate in summer, to welcome travellers. Will you hang them in a pattern?

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: Carry on the pattern of flags. What comes next?

older.prompt: Carry on the pattern: blue, yellow, yellow, red. What comes next?

feedback.all_good: Welcome, travellers! The gate looks splendid.

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Every walker who comes up the road will see those flags and feel welcome. That's what a city should do.

journal_line: I hung welcome flags over Bellhaven's gate with Mrs. Greta.
